comment: GameTest-only (copied into run/config/ProjectE by the prepareGameTestConfig task, never in the jar). As in the Pack, the Transmutation Tablet is worth 0 EMC: the mod gives it to every player for free, so converting it must yield nothing. A value of 0 can only be set here, not in pe_custom_conversions. Raw gold, which GT's gold ore drops, has its Pack value (with ProjectE's raw ore blacklist off in mapping.toml, as in the Pack): the Candidate "new" ore tests (#79) need it discoverable.
